alt: Cubic perovskite SrTiO3: a titanium atom at the cell centre inside an octahedron of six oxygen atoms, strontium at the corners.
caption: Cubic perovskite SrTiO3: the TiO6 octahedron is the building block that tilts and distorts in real perovskites.

steps.title: The cell
steps.text: One strontium, one titanium and three oxygen atoms in a cubic cell.

steps.title: Six oxygens around titanium
steps.text: Join the six nearest oxygen atoms and a cage appears.

steps.title: Look down the c axis
steps.text: From above the octahedron is a square; tilts in real perovskites show up here.
